checks.source_scope: Wikidata cross-check; elements additionally IUPAC/PubChem, currencies active ISO codes. Not an independent second source for every language/capital.

checks.scope: Current structured biography; disputed or ambiguous records quarantined. Selected manual anecdotes corrected; not every surviving manual clue has independent primary-source verification.
All available Wikidata player claims re-read; absence of transfer data cannot certify official completeness. No subjective difficulty changes.

limitations: Structured-source cross-check is not independent primary-source proof for every fact.
Historical league membership is date-scoped; historical clubs and successors remain distinct.
Reviewed knowledge lists held from unsafe automatic merge pending validated replacement sources.
knowledge_import_policy: Reviewed lists are held from unvalidated automatic merging. They require revalidation before replacement.
evidence: Detailed old/new values and source snapshots retained in timestamped content backups; a source cross-check is not proof of every real-world fact.
